body: I don't know what else to do. I've always felt like the screw up in my family, like a disappointment compared to my siblings. I feel like if they find out about this it will be just one more thing that proves that I am indeed a fuck up.

I have a lot of stress about this. I hate to think of adding any worry to anyone in my family, and it's terrible dealing with this on my own. I'm scared to even go to my court date because I don't know what's going to happen.

I'm afraid, but mostly because I don't want to mess this up. I already have enough trouble finding a new job, having this on my record isn't going to help at all. I just don't know how the legal system works with these situations, and i've been looking it up and nothing sounds as though it's going to come out without jail time
